convention: contributions in nat per event; positive = formula worse; hit term = w ln g_MLP - w ln g_F summed over hits in the region, averaged over the events of the group

notes.absolute contribution: coarse_abs = |signed regional total|; coarse_sum_abs_per_hit_terms = event average of sum_i |w_i ln g_MLP - w_i ln g_F| (a scale, not a budget)
notes.native cell: common.locate(z', r) of the hit centre; coarse region by hit-centre coordinates
